## 🚀 Checklist
Before submitting this Pull Request, ensure that:
- [ ] My code follows the coding style guide of this project (PEP 8/Ruff checked).
- [ ] I have run static type checks (`mypy src/`) and resolved all type errors.
- [ ] I have formatted my code using `black`.
- [ ] I have added appropriate unit or integration tests mapping to my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass.
- [ ] My commits conform to the Conventional Commits naming conventions.
- [ ] I have updated documentation files where relevant.
- [ ] There are no security flaws or plaintext passwords checked in.
